items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via StyleSmuggler zero-day
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability, dubbed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce stores. Attacks started on September 4th, and an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) was released on September 7th with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to privilege escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. It has a CVSS score of 9.1 and was addressed in the August 2026 security update.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to arbitrary code execution
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges, with a CVSS score of 8.7.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to arbitrary code execution
items.summary: Another critical stored XSS vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges, with a CVSS score of 7.7.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to security feature bypass
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows a security feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges, with a CVSS score of 7.6.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (B2B) leading to security feature bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability specifically affecting Adobe Commerce B2B, enabling a security feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges, with a CVSS score of 7.5.

items.title: Multiple Critical, Important, and Moderate Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Multiple Critical and Important Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addressing critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Multiple Critical, Important, and Moderate Vulnerabilities
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.
